visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-definition close-up of three golden-brown scallion pancakes resting on a decorative ceramic plate with a floral pattern. A pair of dark wooden chopsticks reaches into the frame from the top left, gently tearing into the crispy skin of one pancake to reveal a vibrant, dense green interior of chopped scallions. The lighting is bright and studio-quality, emphasizing the oily sheen and translucent texture of the rice paper wrapping. (2) The scene shifts to a preparation stage where a clear glass bowl is centered on a light-colored wooden surface. A person's hands, protected by translucent plastic gloves, pour a generous amount of finely chopped green scallions from a small stainless steel bowl into the glass bowl. Following this, small white mounds of salt and granulated sugar are added using a small brush, followed by a spoonful of beige white pepper powder and a drizzle of amber sesame oil from a small glass jug. (3) A top-down view shows a large white ceramic plate filled with clear water. A gloved hand takes a circular, dry rice paper sheet and submerged both sides briefly before lifting it out as it becomes pliable. The wet rice paper is then laid flat onto a light-blue textured plastic cutting board. The background remains clean and minimalist, focusing entirely on the hands and the food components. (4) A metal spoon is used to spread a horizontal line of the green scallion mixture across the bottom third of the wet rice paper. The gloved hands carefully fold the bottom edge over the filling and roll the paper tightly upwards to form a thin cylinder. Once rolled, the hands coil the cylinder from one end to the other into a tight spiral shape, resembling a snail shell, and press the end to seal it. (5) The camera captures the cooking process in a black non-stick frying pan where clear oil has been poured. Three spiral pancakes are placed into the pan and sizzle over medium-low heat. The hands use wooden chopsticks to flip them, showing the surface turning from translucent to a crispy, golden-brown charred texture while the interior scallions retain their bright green color. (6) The final phase returns to the finished dish presentation on the floral plate. The pancakes are stacked and shown in a cross-section, steaming slightly to indicate they are freshly cooked. Brand logos and social media handles for 'wecook123' appear as graphic overlays on the screen. The setting is bright and consistent throughout, maintaining a professional culinary tutorial aesthetic.
